profiles.label: Director Core
profiles.description: Narrative, Design Atlas, manifest planning, and review contracts.

profiles.label: Visual Studio
profiles.description: Static presentation output plus original imagery and product UI capture.

profiles.label: Motion Studio
profiles.description: Visual Studio plus short motion and multi-scene video.

profiles.label: Full Studio
profiles.description: All general presentation capabilities. Spatial 3D remains an on-demand module.

profiles.label: Spatial Studio
profiles.description: Full Studio plus deterministic Three.js scenes inside Remotion.

presentation.label: Editable presentation engine
presentation.fallback: Planning and static poster assets only; no editable PPTX delivery.

install.codex: Open Codex Plugins and install or enable the Presentations capability, then start a new task.
install.claude-code: Install a trusted PPTX or presentation plugin, or configure a project-local PptxGenJS renderer.
install.copilot: Install a trusted presentation Agent Skill or make PptxGenJS available to the project.
install.gemini: Install a trusted presentation extension or make PptxGenJS available to the project.
install.cursor: Install a trusted presentation Agent Skill or make PptxGenJS available to the project.
install.generic: Install a presentation Agent Skill or a compatible PPTX renderer such as PptxGenJS.

image_generation.label: Original image generation
image_generation.fallback: Use user-supplied or licensed imagery; generated hero and concept visuals are unavailable.

install.codex: Open Codex Plugins and install or enable Image Generation, then start a new task.
install.claude-code: Install a trusted image-generation plugin or configure an approved image provider.
install.copilot: Install a trusted image-generation skill or configure an approved image provider.
install.gemini: Install or enable an image-generation extension or configure an approved image provider.
install.cursor: Enable Cursor image generation or install a trusted image-generation skill.
install.generic: Install a trusted image-generation skill or configure an approved image provider.

ui_capture.label: Browser-based product UI capture
ui_capture.fallback: Use supplied screenshots; generated interactive UI capture is unavailable.

install.copilot: Install a browser automation Agent Skill or configure Playwright in the project.
install.gemini: Install a browser automation extension or configure Playwright in the project.
install.cursor: Install a browser automation skill or configure Playwright in the project.
install.generic: Install a browser automation skill or configure Playwright in the project.

short_motion.label: Short deterministic motion
short_motion.fallback: Deliver the approved static poster frame without short-form animation.

video.label: Remotion video production

reference_research.label: Web reference research
